passage.label: Al-An'am — Two scriptural excuses removed by clear proof, guidance and mercy; worst punishment for turning away; awaiting angels, the Lord's coming or His signs ends profitable belief; sects disowned; good tenfold, evil only its like; millat Ibrahim; prayer, sacrifice, life and death for Allah alone; no soul bears another's burden; successors tested by rank; swift penalty, Forgiving, Merciful

arabicExcerpts.text: أَن تَقُولُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ عَلَىٰ طَآئِفَتَيۡنِ مِن قَبۡلِنَا وَإِن كُنَّا عَن دِرَاسَتِهِمۡ لَغَٰفِلِينَ

أَوۡ تَقُولُواْ لَوۡ أَنَّآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ لَكُنَّآ أَهۡدَىٰ مِنۡهُمۡۚ فَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم بَيِّنَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞۚ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَصَدَفَ عَنۡهَاۗ سَنَجۡزِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَصۡدِفُونَ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَصۡدِفُونَ

هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَ رَبُّكَ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَ بَعۡضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَۗ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِي بَعۡضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَ لَا يَنفَعُ نَفۡسًا إِيمَٰنُهَا لَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَامَنَتۡ مِن قَبۡلُ أَوۡ كَسَبَتۡ فِيٓ إِيمَٰنِهَا خَيۡرٗاۗ قُلِ ٱنتَظِرُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُواْ دِينَهُمۡ وَكَانُواْ شِيَعٗا لَّسۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ فِي شَيۡءٍۚ إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُمۡ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشۡرُ أَمۡثَالِهَاۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجۡزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثۡلَهَا وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
قُلۡ إِنَّنِي هَدَىٰنِي رَبِّيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ دِينٗا قِيَمٗا مِّلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۚ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
قُلۡ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحۡيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُۥۖ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرۡتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

قُلۡ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبۡغِي رَبّٗا وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۚ وَلَا تَكۡسِبُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَكُمۡ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَرَفَعَ بَعۡضَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ فِي مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۡۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ

mainSubject.label: Surah close: two scriptural excuses cancelled by a bayyinah of guidance and mercy; denial and turning away earn the worst recompense; awaiting angels, the Lord's coming or His signs ends profitable belief; sects disowned, affair left to Allah; tenfold good versus like-for-like evil without wronging; straight path as qayyim deen and millat Ibrahim haneef; salat, nusuk, living and dying for the Lord of the worlds, no partner, first of the Muslims; self-earning and non-transferable burden; khala'if tested by rank; swift iqab with Ghafoor-Raheem

subordinateSubjects.label: First excuse: the Book was sent only to two groups before us (taifatayni)
Claimed unawareness of their study (AAan dirasatihim laghafileena)
Second excuse: had the Book been sent to us we would have been better guided
Bayyinah from your Lord arriving as huda and rahmah cancels both excuses
Supreme injustice defined as denying Allah's ayat and turning aside (sadafa AAanha)
Worst recompense (sooa alAAathabi) proportioned to the act of turning away
Awaited alternatives: angels coming, your Lord coming, or some of His signs
Faith not previously held or unproductive of good ceases to profit when signs come
Mutual waiting formula quli intathiroo inna muntathiroona
Dividing the religion and becoming sects (shiyaAAan)
Prophetic dissociation lasta minhum fee shayin
Their affair referred to Allah who will inform them of what they did
Tenfold reward for the hasanah (AAashru amthaliha)
Evil recompensed only with its like (illa mithlaha)
No wronging in the reckoning (wahum la yuthlamoona)
Guidance to siratin mustaqeemin described as deenan qiyaman
Millat Ibrahim haneefan as the content of that path
Ibrahim excluded from the mushrikeen
Fourfold dedication: salatee, nusukee, mahyaya, mamatee for Allah
Rabb al-AAalameen as the sole recipient of that dedication
Partner-negation la shareeka lahu with the command received (wabithalika omirtu)
Priority declaration waana awwalu almuslimeena
Sole-lordship question aghayra Allahi abghee rabban answered by rabbu kulli shayin
Self-earning principle wala taksibu kullu nafsin illa AAalayha
Non-transferable burden wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra
Return to the Lord who informs about the matters disputed (takhtalifoona)
Khala'if of the earth as appointed human station
Rank-differentiation raised some above others in darajat
Trial-purpose liyabluwakum fee ma atakum attached to what is given
Swift penalty (sareeAAu alAAiqabi) paired with laghafoorun raheemun

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَ رَبُّكَ أَوۡ يَأۡتِيَ بَعۡضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَۗ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِي بَعۡضُ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكَ لَا يَنفَعُ نَفۡسًا إِيمَٰنُهَا لَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَامَنَتۡ مِن قَبۡلُ أَوۡ كَسَبَتۡ فِيٓ إِيمَٰنِهَا خَيۡرٗاۗ قُلِ ٱنتَظِرُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: say, wait; indeed we too are waiting.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنَّنِي هَدَىٰنِي رَبِّيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ دِينٗا قِيَمٗا مِّلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۚ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: say, my Lord has guided me to a straight path, an upright religion, the way of Ibrahim, inclining to truth, not among the associators.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحۡيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: say, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُۥۖ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرۡتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: declare that He has no partner, that this is what I was commanded, and that I am the first of the Muslims.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: قُلۡ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبۡغِي رَبّٗا وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖۚ وَلَا تَكۡسِبُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ
commandsAndProhibitions.description: Command: say, shall I seek other than Allah as lord while He is Lord of all things? Each soul earns only against itself and no bearer bears another's burden.

propheticNarratives.label: Ibrahim's millat named haneef and explicitly separated from the mushrikeen as the model of the straight path

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Belated faith that neither preceded nor earned good through belief yields no benefit
Total-life devotion spanning worship, sustenance-ritual, living and dying
Islam as submitted identity claimed in the first-person priority declaration

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Religious fragmentation into sects treated as a communal failure disowned by the messenger
Asymmetric moral economy: tenfold credit for good, exact equivalence for evil
Earth-succession and unequal ranks framed as a test of what each has been given

relationships.label: Individual accountability excludes transfer of burden between persons

notes: Pass A An'am passage 16/4 — final section of the surah. The two quoted excuses (6:156-157) close the revelation-apologetic begun at 6:91 by removing both ignorance-of-earlier-scripture and comparative-superiority claims once a bayyinah has arrived. Verse 6:158 links eschatological delay to a closing window for effective belief; the identity of 'some of the signs of your Lord', the manner of the Lord's coming, and how this interacts with acceptance of late repentance are theological questions deferred to scholarly review rather than resolved here. Verse 6:159 disowns sectarian division without naming groups. The tenfold/equivalent asymmetry (6:160) states a recompense ratio without further specification. Verses 6:161-163 form a first-person confession sequence tying the straight path to millat Ibrahim and extending devotion beyond ritual to living and dying; the precise referent of nusuk and of awwalu almuslimeena is left to review. Verse 6:164 combines sole-lordship with non-transferable burden, and 6:165 closes the surah by framing rank inequality as trial and pairing swift penalty with forgiveness and mercy.
